findings.quote: The TTC recommends relocating the existing southbound stop at the northwest corner of Birchmount Road and Rolark Drive to the southwest corner of Birchmount Road and Rolark Drive.
Relocating this stop will mitigate potential conflicts of bus stop service and truck movements north of Rolark Drive.
findings.rule: Relocating this stop will mitigate potential conflicts of bus stop

findings.quote: The relocation of the bus stop will require removal of one tree.
